scope: Independent finite task-design review only. Not robot execution, physical feasibility, simulator/controller implementation, apparatus-safety qualification, complete source closure, or reproduction validation.

source_review.independently_read: Main empirical Results and Methods sections and supplementary experimental/implementation sections; movie-description sheet and reporting-summary text. Checked key fabrication, loading, repetition and computational/physical boundaries.
not_independently_established: exhaustive reread of all article theory and every figure
all source workbook numerical values or raw-trial lineage
complete author code or archived commit
exact manufacturing CAD and original Iris row/load mapping

resolved_findings.repair: Unloaded baseline is explicitly acquired before weights are transferred to the four input nodes.

Ten named transfer contracts and nine typed physical routes bind source/destination, carried objects/carrier, zero-load state and custody readback. Digital analysis leaves robot and specimen at their physical station.
Gradient repeats wrap both reset-separated phases and final pairing. Regression analysis lies outside the seven-mass loop and remains inside the declared trial scope.
Public trained-behavior tokens are neutral A/B; evaluator-only branch keys and Iris labels are excluded from projected actor payload.
Initial/supplied geometry has origin/validation provenance without a fabricated training job; numerical ancestry is conditional.
Source-matched physical completion requires all nine configurations, all seven regression masses and three trials per case; altered or selected subsets are partial/authored departures.
The oracle now rejects a trace lacking its final pair event and rejects unknown phase/event vocabulary; both repaired negatives were independently rerun.

validation.limits: Checks are finite static/symbolic assertions with authored records; they are neither a laboratory runtime nor scientific validation.

scientific_boundary: Physical field measurements/final-network tests are distinct from numerical training, task switching, damage retraining, alternative maps and proposed adaptive hardware. No numerical geometry update changes a printed specimen.

publication_boundary: Only original authored deliverables named by the release allowlist may be copied. Private source bytes, publisher pixels, movies, raw workbook data and unreviewed author code remain excluded. No remote publication performed by this reviewer.
